text:
devin: quick q — proposing a "grace window" slider in fallback controls. operator picks 0-30s to keep preferring primary before degrading. pros/cons?
maria: +1. clarify if this counts against client timeout or is separate. also separate latency vs error triggers.
sam: default 5s. add tooltip: 'prefer primary for this duration; may raise p95'. add a 'simulate spike' button in console.
devin: think three degrade modes: keep_trying (tries primary then fallback), partial_return (return cached/shortened), immediate_fallback (failfast). names can change.
olivia: prefer runbook-friendly labels: keep_trying, partial_return, failfast. easier for on-call.
ops-bot: flag: fallback_grace_v3 rollout -> 20% orgs
maria: telemetry: record trigger_reason, selected_mode, latency_ms_at_trigger, tokens_primary, tokens_fallback, sample_output_id. sampling rate org-configurable.
sam: audit: store sampled raw outputs 90d default, UI replay + diff; gate raw outputs via RBAC.
devin: UX: console should show inline pill on requests that fell back: 'fell back: latency (5.2s) · why' linking to trace.
olivia: include CTA 'compare with primary' to open side-by-side diff.
maria: API: send header X-Redwood-Fallback: mode=keep_trying;trigger=latency;trace=trc123 when fallback happens and optional fallback_meta in body.
sam: curl example: curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate  # header -> X-Redwood-Fallback: mode=partial_return;trigger=error_rate;trace=trc987
devin: sampling defaults? ops-bot suggests org-wide 0.1% sampled traces; 5% for experiment cohorts.
ops-bot: enacted sampling_rate=0.1% / experiment_cohort=5% (tag: fallback_expt=true)
maria: followups: I'll draft runbook copy and tooltip text; add RBAC matrix for raw traces.
sam: add unit tests for header and pill rendering; e2e to simulate delay and verify mode selection.
devin: I'll mock UI and post screenshot here. olivia: recommend emergency operator toggle to force failfast globally for incidents.
maria: action items: 1) telemetry schema PR 2) API header + fallback_meta spec 3) console pill + compare flow 4) RBAC review 5) rollout plan 6) tests
devin: assigning GH tasks next. thanks.
